title: Thought in Bloom

outfit_card.silhouette: A layered hanfu-inspired couture ensemble with a fitted high-collar bodice, sheer organza over-robe with bell sleeves, and a voluminous multi-tiered pleated skirt with a soft bustle back.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: A delicate silver floral hairpin with pearl drops and a thin misty white ribbon entwined in a side braid, accompanied by a petite jade comb.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: High mandarin collar with gilded filigree embroidery, a sheer tulle front panel embellished with pearl and sequin floral beadwork, layered wide bell sleeves with scalloped lace cuffs and sheer silk under-sleeves.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A multi-tiered skirt featuring crisp knife pleats and a tulle overskirt, a voluminous bustle with lace trim, and a decorative tasseled waist sash with jade droplets, paired with pointed silk brocade slippers.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Floating botanical motif of translucent petals and glowing orb-like dewdrops, silver tassel jewelry, and a delicate birdcage-shaped hand prop.
